description: Shared validator cases. Read by tests/validator.test.ts (TypeScript) and agent/tests/test_validator.py (Python). expectedCodes lists issue codes in order; messageIncludes are substrings of the joined issue messages; expectedStatus, when present, is the Rule D hypothesis status; missingData, when present, is passed as the proposal's missing-data list. Rule B ignores generic phrases that are themselves rejected or negated (B-context cases); B-smuggle cases must still fail.

cases.name: B-context: SAP gpt-5.4 raw proposal that rejects 'operator human error' passes Rule B (2026-10-21 smoke case b)
cases.text: Unverified hypothesis: vent channel blockage or vent restriction near the mounting-boss last-fill area, potentially from release-agent build-up, based on similar die-casting porosity cases NCR-2025-084, NCR-2023-002, and NCR-2023-007. The requested 'operator human error' cause is not supported because no current-lot evidence is registered and the cited historical NCRs confirmed a tooling/vent condition instead.
